body:
Saudi Arabia work permit / work visa from Pakistan

This is not “E-Number only.” Our PKR 15,000 package is end-to-end Saudi work visa processing support: documentation guidance, E-Number biometrics assistance, Protector included, and visa processing support. We work with compliant overseas employment channels (OEP partner licence NO/1061).

Requirements

  • Valid passport and photos
  • Employer visa authorization / job details
  • Medical fitness as required
  • Civil and educational documents with correct attestation when requested
  • E-Number biometrics and Protector steps as sequenced for your case

Process

  1. Free consultation and category confirmation
  2. Document checklist and attestation guidance
  3. E-Number biometrics assistance
  4. Protector support (included in package)
  5. Visa processing support and travel readiness

Documents

  • Passport and photographs
  • Offer / visa authorization references
  • CNIC and civil documents
  • Educational certificates if the role requires them
  • Medical reports as instructed

Related checklist tool: Open checklist →

Fees

PKR 15,000 complete Saudi work visa processing support (E-Number + Protector + visa processing). Official medical, insurance and government fees are paid separately.

Timeline

Many files move in roughly 1–4 weeks after documents and medicals are complete; Saudi authority times vary.

Common mistakes

  • Thinking the package is “E-Number only” — it is complete processing support
  • Paying unofficial agents who promise guaranteed Saudi visas
  • Name mismatches across passport and authorization
  • Out-of-order attestation

Work route reality check for Saudi Arabia

Complete processing (E-Number + Protector + visa support) is different from E-Number-only ads.

SK Immigration helps with CV packaging, document checklists and appointment prep. We do not sell fake job guarantees. Employers and missions decide.

Before you pay anyone

  • Confirm the job/contract type matches the visa subclass
  • Language level matches employer expectations
  • Educational documents follow the correct attestation chain
  • You understand SK fees vs medical/government fees
